chip.description: 28-voice sample player ("GEW8") reading a metadata table plus 8-bit or 12-bit linear samples from ROM, with per-voice pan, pitch, envelope and LFO; second-sourced to Sega as the 315-5560.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/multipcm.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Yamaha YMW-258-F 'GEW8' (aka Sega 315-5560) emulation ... Information by R. Belmont and the YMF278B (OPL4) manual").
